subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

It is time to revise the syllabi.

options.text: It is time for the syllabi to be revised.
It is time for the syllabi to revise.
It has been time for the syllabi to revise.
It was time for the syllabi to be revised.

solution:
The correct answer is '**It is time for the syllabi to be revised.**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• It is in the simple present tense.
 
• In order to convert the active voice of simple present tense to passive voice, we use the following structure:
 
 
• Object + i
